description_en: Get the resource capacity of an edge container application
description_zh: 获取边缘容器应用的资源容量
name: GetEdgeContainerAppResourceCapacity

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) API operation to obtain the application ID.

<notice>If ListEdgeContainerApps returns an empty list, call CreateEdgeContainerApp first to create an application and use the returned AppId.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。

<notice>若 ListEdgeContainerApps 返回空列表，请先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用并使用返回的 AppId。</notice>
parameters.name: app_id
